T012.gate: `bash scripts/skill-mirrors.sh --check && grep -q "skill-mirrors.sh --check" scripts/check.sh && t=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R .agents/skills/morning-board "$t"/ && echo x >>"$t"/morning-board/SKILL.md && !
